#Import 65 cleaned articles
```{r}
precivil_complete <- read_csv("precivil_lynching_complete_12_22.csv")
```


#Chart - Results by year
```{r}
#Here is a chart, Figure 1, that describes lynching search results by year
precivil_complete %>% 
   group_by(year) %>% 
  count(year) %>% 
#Sandwich it onto a simple ggplot
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = n)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = c(seq(1830, 1865, 5)), breaks = seq(1830, 1865, 5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 15, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Precivil War Lynching Coverage By Year, 1835-1861", 
       subtitle = "Count of Lynching Stories Examined",
       caption = "n=65  articles. Graphic by Rob Wells, 12/22/2025",
       y="Count of Articles",
       x="Year")
```


year total descending

count(year) %>%

# precivil narrow print specific stories in a text file
```{r}

# Open a connection to the text file
file_conn <- file("dataframe_entries.txt", "w")

# Loop through each row of the dataframe
for (i in 1:nrow(precivil_narrow)) {
  # Extract the row
  row_data <- precivil_narrow[i, c("headline", "newspaper_name", "date", "article", "matches", "article_id", "index")]
  
  # Write each field on a separate line
  writeLines(paste0("Headline: ", row_data$headline), file_conn)
  writeLines(paste0("Newspaper: ", row_data$newspaper_name), file_conn)
  writeLines(paste0("Date: ", row_data$date), file_conn)
  writeLines(paste0("Article ID: ", row_data$article_id), file_conn)
  writeLines(paste0("Index Number: ", row_data$index), file_conn)
  
  # Handle the matches list column
  matches_content <- unlist(row_data$matches)
  if (length(matches_content) > 0) {
    writeLines(paste0("Matches: ", paste(matches_content, collapse = ", ")), file_conn)
  } else {
    writeLines("Matches: None", file_conn)
  }
  
  writeLines(paste0("\nArticle:\n", row_data$article), file_conn)
  
  # Add separator line (except after the last entry)
  if (i < nrow(precivil_narrow)) {
    writeLines("\n**************************************************\n", file_conn)
  }
}

# Close the file connection
close(file_conn)
```
